passives.name: GriffithSilverEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
On Placement:
- Increase all players' units' base damage by {1}% (+{2}% per upgrade)
- Increase all players' $Physical $Archetype units' damage by {3}% (+{4}% per upgrade)
- Increase all players' $Magical $Archetype units' damage by {5}% (+{6}% per upgrade)

The player's most equipped $Archetype gains an additional {7}% damage.
$Buffs from $GriffithSilverPassive1 do not stack.
